title: The Word of Blessing for the Day of Tribulation
action: Enoch delivers a prophetic blessing for the elect and the righteous who will exist in a future day of tribulation, a time when the wicked and impious will be removed.

title: Enoch's Prophetic Commission
action: Enoch, a righteous man, is shown a holy vision by angels, which he understands is not for his own time but for a distant generation of chosen people.

title: A Declaration Concerning the Elect
action: The narrator declares that the Holy and Great One will emerge from His dwelling.

title: Theophany at Sinai
action: A divine figure travels to Mount Sinai, where his host and the might of his power are revealed from heaven.

title: The Terror of the Watchers
action: A great fear and trembling seizes the Watchers and all beings.

title: Theophany Causes Geological Upheaval
action: In a display of immense power, high mountains are shaken and high hills are thrown down, both melting away like wax in a fire.

title: The Judgment and Destruction of the Earth
action: The earth is submerged, all life upon it perishes, and judgment is enacted upon everyone, including the righteous.

title: The Blessing of the Righteous and Elect
action: He makes peace for the righteous, protects the elect, and grants them mercy, fullness, prosperity, blessings, and light.

title: The Execution of Judgment
action: A divine Judge comes with a multitude of Holy Ones to execute judgment upon the Wicked and rebuke them for their sinful deeds.

title: Observation of Celestial Order
action: A call to consider the works of Heaven, specifically how the celestial lights do not alter their paths, but rise and set according to their ordained, unchangeable schedule and laws.

title: The Unchanging Works on Earth
action: The Observers are instructed to see and understand the Earth, noting that its work does not change from the beginning to the end, as the works of God are made manifest.

title: Observation of the Seasons
action: The whole earth is observed to be filled with water, while clouds, dew, and rain rest upon it during summer and winter.

title: The Observation of the Trees
action: A contrast is observed between trees that appear withered and shed their leaves, and a specific group of fourteen trees that retain their old leaves for two to three years until new leaves appear.

title: The Heat of a Summer Day
action: Observers are instructed to seek shade and shadow to escape the scorching heat of the sun, as the earth itself burns.

title: Chapter 5 Segment 1
action: Observing trees as they cover themselves with green leaves and bear fruit, and recognizing that 'He that liveth for ever' created all his works.

title: Pronouncement of the Curse
action: A curse is pronounced upon a group, condemning their days, shortening the years of their lives, and establishing an eternal curse with no mercy.

title: Chapter 5 Segment 6: A Prophecy of Fates
action: A prophecy declares that in 'those days,' peace will be given to the righteous, while the sinners will be cursed for eternity, sharing a common fate.

title: The Fate of the Chosen and the Wicked
action: A pronouncement dictates the future state: 'the chosen' will receive light, joy, peace, and inherit the earth, while 'the wicked' will receive a curse.

title: The State of the Elect
action: Describing the eternal state of the Elect, who are granted wisdom and will live without experiencing wickedness or pride again.

title: The Promise of Unending Life
action: A declaration is made that a group of people will not have their lives diminished or die by plague or wrath, but will complete their days and live long lives in peace and abundant joy.

title: Birth of Daughters to Men
action: Daughters, described as beautiful and lovely, are born to the children of men.

title: The Decision of the Sons of Heaven
action: The Sons of Heaven see the Daughters of Men, desire them, and decide to take them as wives to beget children.

title: Shemyaza's Fear
action: Shemyaza, their leader, says to his companions that he fears they will not agree to undertake a specific deed, leaving him solely responsible for the great sin.

title: The Angels' Oath
action: A group of angels swear a binding oath together, pledging not to abandon their plan and to execute a specific deed.

title: Prologue: The Blessing of Enoch
action: The text introduces a blessing from Enoch, the prophet. This blessing is for a future generation—the elect and righteous—who will be present during a 'Day of Tribulation' when all wicked and godless individuals will be removed.

title: Enoch Receives the Heavenly Vision
action: Enoch, a righteous man in a state of vision, sees a holy revelation of the heavens shown to him by angels. He hears and understands that the message is not for his own time, but for a remote future generation known as 'the elect'.

title: The Coming of the Holy and Great One
action: Enoch continues his discourse concerning 'The Elect' and proclaims that 'The Holy and Great One' will come forth from his dwelling, and his arrival will encompass the world.

title: The Theophany at Sinai
action: The Holy and Great One travels from his dwelling to Mount Sinai, where his host appears and his power is manifested from heaven.

title: The Cosmic Terror
action: A great fear and trembling seizes the Watchers and all other beings, extending to the ends of the earth as a reaction to the preceding theophany.

title: The Mountains Melt
action: As a result of a powerful theophany, high mountains are violently shaken and hills are brought low, melting away like wax in a fire.

title: Chapter 10 Segment 4
action: The text describes an action involving binding and casting into darkness, but specific details are not extractable due to language analysis limitations.

title: Declaration of the Vision
action: An unnamed Narrator describes seeing a great vision ('ራእይ') and declares its content, which is a book of righteousness and rebuke concerning the Watchers. Men are expected to speak about it and understand it with their hearts.

title: Binding of Transgressors
action: An implied entity is angry with and binds the transgressors until the completion of their sin, for a year of mystery.

title: Introduction of Holy Angels
action: An introductory statement listing the names of holy angels who watch.

title: The Parable of the Trees
location: An unspecified natural landscape with trees.
action: An instruction is given to observe how all trees appear withered and shed their leaves, with the exception of fourteen specific trees that remain evergreen through two or three winters.

title: The Unbearable Heat of Summer
location: A sun-scorched landscape of earth and rock
action: During the hot summer days, a group of people are unable to travel across the land because the sun has made the ground too hot to walk on. They are forced to seek shade for relief.

title: The Unchanging Order of the Heavens
action: The luminaries in heaven are observed to follow their prescribed paths, rising and setting in their seasons without changing or transgressing their commands.

title: The Unchanging Work on Earth
action: The work of God upon the earth is observed and understood to be constant and unchanging from its beginning to its end.

title: The Order of the Seasons on Earth
action: During summer and winter, the earth is observed to be filled with water, and cloud, dew, and rain rest upon it.

title: Enoch's Prophetic Commission
action: Enoch delivers words of blessing, recounting how he, a righteous man, saw a holy vision from the heavens shown by angels. He understands the vision is for a remote generation, not his own.

title: The Theophany on Sinai
location: From a divine Dwelling Place to Mount Sinai, with effects felt across the Earth.
action: The Holy and Great One, the God of the world, comes forth from His dwelling, treads upon Mount Sinai, and appears with power from heaven. This event causes universal fear, making the Watchers tremble and the mountains and hills collapse and melt.

title: The Universal Judgment
action: The Earth is submerged and everything on it is destroyed. Judgment is executed upon all. God provides peace and protection for the Righteous and the Elect, who will be blessed with His light. God arrives with ten thousands of His Holy Ones to destroy the impious and reprove all flesh for their sinful deeds.

title: Nature's Obedience as a Rebuke
action: A speaker questions how trees are covered in green leaves and how all of God's works are performed annually without change, and how seas and rivers complete their tasks together, contrasting this order with the disobedience of the addressees.

title: Judgment on the Impatient and Hard-hearted
action: The speaker directly accuses the addressees ('you') of impatience, disobedience to the Lord's command, and speaking arrogant words against God's majesty. They are declared 'hard of heart' and told they will have no peace.

title: Pronouncement of Curses and Blessings
action: The speaker pronounces that the sinners will curse their own days and shorten their lives, receiving an eternal curse without mercy. In contrast, the elect will receive light, joy, and peace, and will inherit the earth. The sinners will be cursed by the righteous.

title: The Fate of the Elect
action: The speaker elaborates on the blessings for the elect: they will be given wisdom, live without repeating sin through wickedness or pride, not be judged, and not die by plague or wrath. They will complete their lifespan in peace and joy for all their days.

title: The Union and Forbidden Knowledge
action: 'The Others' take human wives, cohabit with them, and teach them forbidden knowledge (charms, enchantments, and knowledge of plants and roots).

title: The Birth of Giants
action: The human wives become pregnant and give birth to great Giants, three thousand ells in height.

title: The Great Consumption
action: The Giants consume all of mankind's provisions, to the point where humanity can no longer sustain them.

title: The Rampage
action: The Giants turn against mankind and devour them. They then begin to sin against all animal life (birds, beasts, reptiles, fish), devour each other's flesh, and drink blood.

title: The Earth's Accusation
action: The personified Earth lays accusation against the Lawless Ones for their transgressions.

title: The Descent and Pact
location: Begins in an unspecified celestial realm, concludes on Ardis, the summit of Mount Hermon.
action: A group of 200 angels, called the Children of Heaven, see and desire the beautiful daughters of men. Led by Semyaza, who initially expresses fear of the sin, they agree to bind themselves with a mutual oath. They descend to Ardis on Mount Hermon and swear the oath, giving the mountain its name. The text then lists the names of the chiefs of this group.

title: Azazel's Teachings
action: Azazel teaches mankind the art of making swords, knives, shields, breastplates, and the knowledge of metals, bracelets, ornaments, antimony, precious stones, and dyes.

title: The Great Corruption
action: Great godlessness and fornication spread, and mankind goes astray and becomes corrupt in all their ways.

title: The Watchers' Lessons
action: Amezarak teaches enchanters and root-cutters; Armaros teaches the resolving of enchantments; Baraqel teaches astrology; Kokabel teaches signs; Tamiel teaches astronomy; and Asradel teaches the course of the moon.

title: The Cry of Mankind
action: As mankind is destroyed, they cry out, and their voice ascends to heaven.

title: The Archangels' Indictment
action: Michael, Gabriel, Suriel, and Urian look down from Heaven, see the Earth filled with blood and lawlessness, and report to the Most High. They convey the cries of the dead, indict Azazel for teaching forbidden knowledge and Semyaza for leading his followers to mate with human women, which produced Giants and filled the Earth with violence. They ask God what should be done.

title: The Opening of the Storehouses
location: A conceptual space spanning heaven and earth.
action: The Speaker proclaims they will open the storehouses of blessing in heaven and send the blessing down upon the work and labor of the children of men on earth.

title: The Eternal Partnership
action: It is stated that Peace and Righteousness will become partners for all time and all generations.

title: The Hidden Life of Enoch
action: The narrator recounts that before these events, Enoch was taken and hidden from mankind, living his days among the Holy Ones and the Watchers.

title: The Commission of Enoch
action: While Enoch is blessing the Lord, the loyal Watchers call to him, addressing him as 'Enoch the scribe', and command him to deliver a message to their fallen brethren.

title: The Judgment on the Fallen
location: the earth (as subject of the message)
action: The message for the fallen Watchers is detailed: they will have no peace or forgiveness on Earth, they will witness the slaughter of their children, and their eternal supplication will not bring them mercy.

title: The Judgment of Azazel
action: Enoch passes on and speaks to Azazel, informing him that a great judgment has gone out against him and there will be no peace, mercy, or supplication for him because of the iniquity he taught.

title: The Petition of the Fallen Angels
action: Enoch goes and speaks to all the other fallen angels together. They become terrified and ask him to write a memorial petition for them for forgiveness, so that he might take it up to the God of heaven, as they are too ashamed to speak or look up to heaven.

title: The Vision at the Waters of Dan
action: Enoch writes their petition. He then goes and sits down at the waters of Dan, south of the west of Armon, and reads their petition until he falls asleep. He dreams a vision of chastisement to deliver to the children of heaven.

title: The Rebuke at Ublesyael
action: Enoch awakens and goes to the fallen angels, finding them gathered together, weeping with their faces covered. He stands before them and begins to recount the vision and speak words of righteousness to rebuke them.

title: The Fate of the Spirits
action: In a time of death and destruction, spirits emerge from their flesh, which decays without judgment. These spirits will continue to cause destruction until the great day of consummation, when the Watchers and the wicked will also face their end.

title: The Recalled Intercession
action: An intercessor is reminded that they were sent to plead on behalf of the Watchers, who were formerly in heaven.

title: The Condemnation for the Revealed Mystery
action: The Watchers are condemned for having learned a worthless mystery while in heaven and revealing it to women, which has caused women and men to multiply evil on earth.

title: Declaration of No Peace
action: A final sentence is delivered to the Watchers, declaring that they will have no peace.

title: The Judgment on the Watchers
action: The Voice commands Enoch to approach and then delivers a divine judgment, explaining why the Watchers' request for intercession is denied. The speech details their fall from a spiritual to a carnal state, the creation of the Giants, and the origin and destructive nature of the Evil Spirits that arise from the Giants' dead bodies.

title: Uriel's Prophecy of Judgment
action: Uriel explains to Enoch that this is the place where the spirits of the angels who joined with women will stand for judgment. He describes how they corrupted mankind, leading them to worship demons, and states they will be judged here until they are finished.

title: Enoch's Unique Vision
action: Enoch reflects that he alone has seen this vision of the ends of all things, and no other human has seen what he has seen.

title: The Names and Roles of the Holy Angels Who Watch
action: An enumeration of the seven archangels and their specific domains of authority.

title: The Uncreated Place of the Seven Stars
location: A place where nothing was created
action: Enoch travels to a formless, terrible place. He sees seven stars, bound and burning like mountains, and questions why they are imprisoned. The angel Uriel explains they are being punished for transgressing God's command until the end of time.

title: The Fiery Prison of the Angels
action: Enoch travels from the first location to a second, more terrible one. He sees a great burning fire, a chasm, and immense pillars of fire descending into an abyss. Terrified, he questions the sight, and Uriel explains that this place is the eternal prison for the angels.

title: Arrival at the Mountain of the Dead
action: The Narrator travels to a new place and is shown a great, high mountain made of hard rock, containing four beautiful, deep, and wide hollows.

title: The Purpose of the Hollows
action: Raphael explains to the Narrator that the hollows were created to gather the spirits of the souls of all the children of men until their appointed time of judgment.

title: The Crying Spirit
action: The Narrator sees the spirits of the dead and hears one voice crying out and accusing, its sound reaching to heaven. He asks Raphael who this spirit is.

title: The Accusation of Abel
action: Raphael reveals the crying spirit is Abel, who was murdered by his brother Cain. Abel's spirit accuses Cain until his lineage is destroyed from the face of the earth.

title: The Fourfold Division of Souls
location: The four hollows within the Mountain in the West
action: In response to the Narrator's question about the separation of spirits, Raphael details the four distinct holding places: one for the righteous with light and a spring of water; one for sinners who died without judgment and now await it in great tribulation; one for the souls of the murdered who make accusation; and one for consummate sinners who will never be raised.

title: Blessing the Lord of Glory
action: Having understood the system of judgment, the Narrator blesses the Lord of Glory and Righteousness, who reigns over all forever.

title: The Running Fire at the Ends of the Earth
action: The Narrator travels to a new location at the ends of the earth. There, he sees a fire that runs without rest and asks about its nature. The angel Raguel explains that this fire is the cosmic force that pursues all the luminaries of heaven.

title: Journey to the Fiery Mountain
action: The Narrator travels from a previous location to a new place where his guide shows him a mountain of fire that burns continuously.

title: Discovery of the Seven Mountains
action: The Narrator approaches the fiery mountain and sees seven glorious, jewel-like mountains, arranged symmetrically with three to the east, three to the north, and one in the center, separated by deep valleys.

title: The Central Mountain and the Unique Tree
action: The Narrator observes the seventh, central mountain, which resembles a throne and is surrounded by fragrant trees. Among them is a unique tree with an unparalleled scent, eternal leaves, flowers, and wood, and beautiful fruit.

title: The Guide Revealed
action: The Narrator expresses his admiration for the beautiful tree, and his guide, who is revealed to be the angel Michael, responds to him.

title: Enoch's Inquiry
action: Enoch asks the Angel Guide about the purpose and fragrance of a specific tree.

title: The Mountain and the Tree
action: The Angel Guide explains that the mountain is a future throne for the Lord's visitation and that the fragrant tree is sacred, untouchable by mortals until the great judgment, after which it will be given to the righteous.

title: The Reward of the Righteous
location: The High Mountain (narrating about The Holy Place)
action: The Angel Guide describes the future: the tree will be transplanted to the Holy Place, its fruit will grant life to the elect, and they will live long, joyful lives on earth, free from all suffering.

title: Enoch's Blessing
action: Enoch blesses the Lord of Glory for creating and preparing such a reward for the righteous people.

title: The Question of the Accursed Valley
action: Enoch observes a blessed, tree-filled land with an accursed valley in its midst and asks Raphael for an explanation.

title: The Valley of Judgment
action: Raphael explains that the accursed valley is reserved for the eternal judgment of those who blaspheme the Lord, and that the righteous will witness this judgment and bless the Lord from there.

title: Enoch's Blessing
action: After hearing Raphael's explanation, Enoch blesses the Lord of Glory for his greatness.

title: Arrival at the Blessed Place
action: The narrator travels to the 'middle of the earth' and discovers a blessed, shaded spot featuring a cut tree from which other trees miraculously sprout.

title: Survey of the Holy Mountains and Valleys
action: From a vantage point, the narrator observes a holy mountain with a northward-flowing stream, a second mountain to the east, a third lower mountain to the west, and the deep, rocky valleys between them. The narrator marvels at the sight.

title: Discovery of the Watered Wilderness
action: The narrator travels east into a mountain within a desert, discovering a place that, while described as a 'solitary wilderness', is paradoxically full of trees, gushing water, flowing channels, and ascending dew.

title: Journey to the Place of Fragrant Trees
action: The narrator travels from a desert to a new place near a mountain and observes unique, fragrant trees of judgment.

title: The Inexhaustible Valleys of the East
location: A vantage point above the mountain of the east
action: The narrator observes a landscape with inexhaustible valleys of water, a beautiful fragrant tree, and cinnamon, before continuing his journey eastward.

title: Vision of the First Mountain
action: The narrator observes a mountain with trees, from which flows water and a fragrant substance named Sarara and Galbanum.

title: Vision of the Second Mountain
action: The narrator observes a second mountain situated on top of the first, this one bearing hard, full aloe trees.

title: The Quality of the Fruit
action: It is described that when an unnamed group takes the fruit from the trees, its fragrance is superior to all others.

title: The Seven Fragrant Mountains
action: The narrator observes and then travels over seven mountains covered in fragrant plants.

title: Journey to the Garden
location: Region east of the mountains, over the Erythraean Sea
action: The narrator travels far to the east, passing over the Erythraean Sea and beyond the angel Zutu'el.

title: Arrival in the Garden of Righteousness
action: The narrator arrives in the Garden, observes its many great and fragrant trees, and takes special note of the Tree of Wisdom and its fruit.

title: The Story of the Tree
action: The angel Raphael explains that the Tree of Wisdom is the one from which Adam and Eve ate, causing their eyes to be opened and their subsequent exile from the Garden.

title: The Three Gates of the West
action: The narrator travels from an unspecified location to the west, at the ends of the earth, and there sees three open gates, which he compares in size to gates he had previously seen in the east.

title: Journey to the Eastern Edge
action: The narrator travels towards the east to the ends of the earth and beholds a great and glorious wonder.

title: The Gates of the Winds
action: The narrator observes three open gates in heaven. Winds emerge from them towards the east, bringing cold, hail, frost, dew, and rain. A wind from one gate is gentle, while winds from the other two are forceful and violent upon the earth.

title: Observation of the Changing Fauna
action: The narrator travels to the ends of the earth and observes great beasts and birds, each distinct and different from the others in form, appearance, and sound.

title: The Open Gates of Heaven
action: At the ends of the earth, the narrator observes the place where the sky rests and sees that the gates of heaven are open.

title: Scribing the Celestial Order
action: Guided by the angel Uriel, the narrator observes, counts, and writes down the details of the stars as they emerge from the gates. Uriel also shows him everything and writes down their names, laws, and works.

title: Vision of the Southern Gates
action: The Narrator travels to the south, to the ends of the earth, and sees three open gates of heaven from which the south wind, dew, rain, and wind emerge.

title: Vision of the Eastern Gates
action: The Narrator travels from the south to the east, to the ends of heaven, and sees three open gates of heaven with smaller gates upon them.

title: The Course of the Stars
action: The Narrator observes the stars of heaven passing through one of the small eastern gates and traveling westward on a designated path.

title: Praise for the Creator's Works
action: Upon seeing the cosmic order, the Narrator blesses the Lord of Glory for His great works, which are revealed to angels and human souls so they may praise Him.

title: Prologue: The Vision and Genealogy
action: The text introduces the second vision of wisdom seen by Enoch and establishes his lineage back to Adam.

title: Enoch's Proclamation
action: Enoch addresses the inhabitants of the earth, both past and future, to deliver the words of wisdom he has now received from the Lord of Spirits, along with a portion of eternal life.

title: Appearance of the Righteous and Judgment of Sinners
action: When the congregation of the righteous appears, sinners are judged for their sins and driven from the face of the dry ground.

title: Revelation of Light and the Fate of Deniers
action: The righteous one appears, light is revealed for the righteous and chosen, and the fate of those who denied the Lord of Spirits is lamented.
actors_involved: those who have denied the Lord of Spirits

title: Expulsion of the Wicked
location: presence of the righteous and chosen
action: When the hidden things of the righteous are revealed, the wicked are judged and driven from the presence of the righteous and chosen.

title: The Fall of the Powerful
action: Those who possess the earth lose their power and cannot behold the holy ones, as the light of the Lord of Spirits shines upon the righteous.

title: Surrender of the Kings
location: the hands of the righteous and the holy
action: The kings and the mighty perish and are delivered into the hands of the righteous and the holy.

title: Finality of Judgment
action: No one can seek mercy from the Lord of Spirits any longer, because their life has ended.

title: The Descent of the Heavenly Children
action: The chosen and holy children descend from the heavens and their seed becomes one with the children of men.

title: Enoch's Commission and Ascent
action: Enoch takes books of judgment, the Lord of Spirits declares no mercy, and Enoch is snatched from earth to the end of the heavens by a cloud and whirlwind.

title: Vision of the Heavenly Dwellings
action: Enoch sees the dwellings of the righteous, holy, and angels, who pray for humanity. He sees them shining and praising the Lord of Spirits under His wings.

title: Enoch's Predestined Portion
action: Enoch desires to dwell in the heavenly place, recognizing it as his pre-ordained portion, and praises the Lord of Spirits.

title: The Unsleeping Praise
action: Enoch sees beings who do not sleep as they stand and eternally praise the Lord of Spirits.

title: Enoch's Transformation
action: Enoch's face is transformed to the point that he is unable to see.

title: Vision of the Four Angels before the Lord of Spirits
action: The narrator witnesses a countless multitude before the Lord of Spirits. He sees four glorious beings on the four sides of the Lord, and hears their four distinct voices: the first blesses the Lord of Spirits, the second blesses the Elect One and the Elect Ones, the third intercedes for those on Earth, and the fourth repels the satans. The narrator asks his guide, the Angel of Peace, about their identities, and is told they are the archangels Michael, Raphael, Gabriel, and Phanuel.

title: Vision of Celestial Order
action: The narrator observes lightnings and stars being called by name, and sees the Balance of Righteousness weighing them according to their light, place, and revolution. This revolution is linked to the number of angels.

title: Interpretation of the Vision
action: The narrator asks his angelic guide about the things he has seen. The angel explains that the Lord of Spirits has shown him a parable, and that the celestial bodies are the names of the righteous who dwell on the dry ground.

title: Wisdom's Search
action: Wisdom seeks a dwelling place among the children of men but does not find one.

title: Wisdom's Return
action: Wisdom returns to her place in the heavens and takes her seat among the angels.

title: Iniquity's Arrival
action: Iniquity leaves her chambers and finds a dwelling among the children of men, succeeding where Wisdom failed.

title: Vision of Celestial Secrets and Judgment
action: Enoch witnesses the secrets of the heavens: how the kingdom is divided for judgment, how human deeds are weighed, the separate abodes for the righteous and the fate of sinners. He then sees the celestial storehouses for weather phenomena like lightning, wind, clouds, dew, hail, and mist, and observes the precise, ordained paths of the sun and moon, all operating under the ultimate authority and judgment of the Lord of Spirits.

title: The Origin of Lightning from Stars
action: The Narrator observes how lightning emerges from the stars, becomes manifest, and yet remains unable to separate from its origin.

title: The Heavenly Court Receives the Cry of the Righteous
location: Heavens, before the Throne of Glory
action: The prayer and blood of the righteous ascend from Earth to the Lord of Spirits. In response, the holy ones in heaven intercede for judgment. The Head of Days is seen on his throne, with the books of the living opened and the heavenly host in attendance. The plea of the righteous is heard and their blood is vindicated, causing the holy ones to rejoice.

title: The Parable of the Deniers' Fate
action: A parable describes that those who deny the Lord of Spirits and the dwelling of the holy ones will neither ascend to heaven nor arrive on earth, but are reserved for a day of tribulation.

title: The Judgment on the Throne of Glory
location: A place of judgment with the throne of glory
action: The Chosen One sits on the throne of glory to examine the deeds of sinners, while the spirits of the righteous who hoped in the Lord's name are strengthened by seeing him.

title: The Transformation of Heaven and Earth
action: The Lord of Spirits places his Chosen One among the righteous, transforms heaven into eternal light and earth into a blessed home for the righteous, while barring and destroying the sinners from it.

title: Vision of the Head of Days and the Son of Man
action: The narrator beholds a vision of the Head of Days and, with him, another being identified as the Son of Man.

title: Inquiry about the Son of Man
action: The narrator asks his angelic guide about the identity of the Son of Man and why he is with the Ancient of Days.

title: Prophecy of the Son of Man's Judgment
action: The angel explains that the Son of Man was chosen by the Lord of Spirits to execute judgment upon the wicked kings, the mighty, and the strong, casting them down from power and into darkness.

title: Expulsion of the Wicked
action: The wicked, who worship idols and deny the Lord of Spirits, are driven out from the houses of the faithful.

title: The Vision of the Fountains
location: A visionary space containing the Fountains of Righteousness and Wisdom.
action: The narrator sees an inexhaustible Fountain of Righteousness surrounded by many Fountains of Wisdom. The thirsty drink from them, are filled with wisdom, and come to dwell with the righteous, holy, and elect.

title: The Naming of the Son of Man
location: Presence of the Lord of Spirits
action: The Son of Man is named in the presence of the Lord of Spirits, before the sun, signs, and stars were created.

title: The Role of the Son of Man
action: The Son of Man's purpose is declared: he will be a staff (of a spiritual kind) for the righteous, a light for the Gentiles, and a hope for the troubled. All who dwell on earth will fall down and worship before him.
actors_involved: Those who are troubled in their hearts
All who dwell on the dry ground

title: The Revelation of the Hidden One
action: It is explained that the Son of Man was chosen and hidden before the world's creation. The Wisdom of the Lord of Spirits reveals him to the holy and righteous, whose portion has been preserved because they rejected the world of unrighteousness.
actors_involved: Wisdom of the Lord of Spirits

title: The Judgment of the Rulers
action: The kings of the earth and the strong are described as becoming humbled and downcast. On the day of their anguish, they cannot save themselves and are destroyed like grass in fire and lead in water before the righteous and holy.
actors_involved: Kings of the earth and the Strong

title: The Final Fall
action: On the day of their trouble, the kings and the strong fall down and do not rise again. No one is there to lift them because they denied the Lord of Spirits and his Anointed.
actors_involved: Kings of the earth and the Strong

title: The Nature and Qualities of the Elect One
location: Presence of the Lord of Spirits
action: The text describes the eternal nature of the Elect One, who stands before the Lord of Spirits. Wisdom is poured out like water, and various spirits (wisdom, insight, instruction, might, and of the righteous dead) dwell within him. Unrighteousness is contrasted as being transient like a shadow.

title: The Elect One as Judge
location: Presence of the Lord of Spirits
action: The Elect One is established as the judge of secret things, before whom no one can speak a vain word. This role is affirmed by his position before the Lord of Spirits and by divine will.

title: The Restoration of the Righteous
action: In 'those days', a return is made for the holy and chosen. The light of days dwells upon them, and glory and honor return to them.

title: The Day of Tribulation
action: On the day of tribulation, evil is gathered upon the sinners. The righteous are victorious in the name of the Lord of Spirits, and this is shown to 'the others' so that they might repent and abandon the work of their hands.

title: The Final Verdict
location: Presence of the Lord of Spirits
action: The Lord of Spirits, in his righteous judgment and glory, declares that those who do not repent will be destroyed before him. He states that from that point on, he will no longer have mercy on them.

title: The Surrender of the Dead
action: The personified Earth, Sheol, and destruction return the dead they have been holding.

title: The Enthronement of the Elect One
action: The Elect One arises, sits on his throne, and is glorified by the Lord of Spirits. He chooses the righteous and holy for salvation.

title: Cosmic Rejoicing
action: In response to the Elect One's manifestation, mountains and hills leap and skip, and the angels' faces shine with joy.

title: The New Habitation
action: The Earth rejoices as the righteous and the elect dwell, walk, and tread upon it.

title: Transport by Whirlwind
location: From the place of vision to The West
action: The narrator, Enoch, is seized by a whirlwind and transported to the West.

title: Vision of the Metal Mountains
action: Enoch sees the secrets of heaven, including six mountains made of iron, copper, silver, gold, soft metal, and lead.

title: Explanation of the Vision
action: Enoch asks the accompanying angel about the mountains. The angel explains they are for the dominion of the Messiah on earth.

title: Prophecy of Dissolution
action: The Angel of Peace elaborates that before the Elect One, these mountains will melt like wax before fire and flow like water, becoming weak. The metals will become useless for wealth or war.

title: The Day of the Elect One
action: A prophecy that when the Elect One appears before the Lord of Spirits, all these metals will be denied and destroyed from the face of the earth.

title: The Vision of the Insatiable Valley
location: A vantage point overlooking the Deep Valley
action: The narrator observes a deep, wide-mouthed valley that never fills, despite all the inhabitants of the world bringing offerings to it.

title: The Fate of the Sinners
action: The narrator perceives the fate of sinners: they will be destroyed from the presence of the Lord of Spirits and driven from His earth into eternal punishment.

title: Preparation for Judgment
action: The narrator sees angels of punishment preparing instruments for Satan. He asks his guide, the angel of peace, who the instruments are for, and is told they are for the kings and the mighty to be destroyed in the valley.

title: The Future Transformation
action: The narrator learns that after the judgment, the house of the righteous will appear, mountains will be leveled, hills will become fountains, and the righteous will find rest.

title: Vision of the Fiery Valley
action: The Narrator sees a deep, fiery valley. The kings and the mighty are brought and cast into it. The Narrator then sees their weightless iron fetters being made.

title: Inquiry about the Punishment
action: The Narrator asks the angel of peace about the purpose of the fetters. The angel explains they are for the hosts of Azazel, who will be seized, cast down, and have their jaws covered with stones as commanded by the Lord of Spirits.

title: The Great Day of Judgment
action: Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, and Phanuel cast the condemned (servants of Satan) into a burning furnace to enact the vengeance of the Lord of Spirits for leading astray the inhabitants of the earth.
actors_involved: those who dwell upon the dry land

title: The Cosmic Flood
action: The punishment of the Lord of Spirits is unleashed. The storehouses of water above and below are opened, and the resulting flood destroys all inhabitants on the dry land, who perish after recognizing their unrighteousness.
actors_involved: those who dwell upon the dry land
those who dwell beneath the ends of the heaven

title: The Declaration of the Head of Days
location: An unspecified divine space, encompassing the concepts of heaven and earth.
action: The Head of Days regrets a past destruction, swears an oath to establish a new covenant with the dwellers of the earth, and decrees a future judgment. This judgment will be executed by angels and will culminate in the powerful kings witnessing the Elect One sitting on the throne of glory to judge Azazel and his followers.

title: Vision of the Angels of Punishment
action: The Narrator sees a vision of angels of punishment walking and holding chains of iron and bronze.

title: The Narrator's Inquiry
action: The Narrator asks the Angel of Peace, who is walking with him, for whom the angels with chains are going.

title: The Valley of Judgment
action: The Angel of Peace explains that the wicked are to be thrown into the deep valley for the sake of the Lord's chosen and beloved, and the day of their life and error will end.

title: The Stirring of the Eastern Kings
action: Angels gather and go to the East to incite the kings of Parthia and Media, putting a spirit of disturbance upon them and driving them from their thrones.

title: Invasion of the Land of the Chosen
action: The agitated kings, like lions and wolves, ascend and trample the Land of the Chosen, turning it into a threshing floor and a path.

title: The Self-Destruction of the Invaders
action: The City of the Righteous becomes an obstacle for the invaders' horses. They turn on one another in slaughter, with no man recognizing his brother, and no son his father or mother, until a great number of corpses is amassed.

title: Sheol Swallows the Sinners
action: Sheol opens its mouth and swallows the sinners, destroying them in front of the chosen.

title: Vision of the Chariots
location: An unspecified vantage point observing the sky
action: The narrator witnesses a vision of men on chariots arriving on the wind from the east and west until midday.

title: The Cosmic Tumult
action: The sound of the chariots creates a tumult, which is perceived by the Holy Ones in heaven and shakes the Pillar of the Earth from its place. The sound is heard from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.

title: Universal Worship
location: An unspecified gathering place on Earth
action: Everyone falls down and worships the Lord of Spirits.

title: The Third Parable's Introduction
action: The speaker begins to deliver a third parable concerning the destiny of the righteous and the chosen.

title: The Blessed State
action: The glorious portion of the righteous and chosen is described, where they will exist in the light of the sun and the light of eternal life, with their days being without end.

title: The Quest in the Heavens
action: The holy ones are instructed to seek the hidden things of righteousness and faith in the heavens, because a new light has dawned and darkness has passed away.

title: The Establishment of Eternal Light
action: It is declared that the former darkness has been destroyed and an un-numerable light is established forever before the Lord of Spirits.

title: Vision of the Ordinance of Lightning and Lights
action: The Narrator observes the secrets of lightnings and lights, which flash for blessing or curse according to the will of the Lord of Spirits.

title: Vision of the Secrets of Thunder
action: The Narrator observes thunder in the Heights of Heaven, which reveals the Dwellings of the Dry Land and acts according to the will of the Lord of Spirits.

title: Confirmation of the Vision of Lights
action: The Narrator is shown again the secrets of the lights and lightnings, confirming they flash for blessing and abundance.

title: The Command to the Rulers
action: The Lord commands the kings and mighty of the earth to open their eyes and recognize the Elect One.
actors_involved: The Elect One / Son of Man
Kings, the Mighty, and the Exalted

title: The Enthroned Judge
action: The Lord of Spirits sits on his throne of glory, and the spirit of righteousness is poured out upon the Elect One. The word from his mouth slays all sinners and the lawless.
actors_involved: The Elect One / Son of Man

title: The Terror of the Kings
action: The kings and mighty stand and see the Son of Man enthroned. They are seized with pain, like a woman in childbirth, and their faces are downcast.
actors_involved: Kings, the Mighty, and the Exalted
The Elect One / Son of Man

title: The Revelation of the Hidden One
action: It is explained that the Son of Man was hidden from the beginning but is now revealed to the elect, who stand before him. The congregation of the holy is sown.
actors_involved: The Elect One / Son of Man

title: The Condemnation of the Kings
action: The kings and mighty fall on their faces, worship, and beg for mercy from the Son of Man. The Lord of Spirits drives them away in haste, their faces filling with shame and darkness. The Angels of Punishment take them to exact retribution.
actors_involved: Kings, the Mighty, and the Exalted
The Elect One / Son of Man

title: The Exaltation of the Righteous
action: The righteous and elect are saved and rejoice. They rise from the earth, are clothed in the Garment of Life (which is the Son of Man), and will dwell, eat, and rise with the Lord of Spirits and the Son of Man forever.
actors_involved: The Elect One / Son of Man

title: Plea for Respite
action: The Kings and the Mighty, held by the Angels of Punishment, petition for a brief rest so they can fall down, worship, and confess their sins before the Lord of Spirits.
actors_involved: The Kings, the Mighty, and the High Ones

title: Lament and Confession
action: The Kings and the Mighty praise the Lord of Spirits, acknowledge his righteousness, and lament their own state. They confess they did not praise God and put their trust in their thrones and scepters, which now cannot save them. They express their despair as light has passed from them and darkness is their eternal home.
actors_involved: The Kings, the Mighty, and the High Ones

title: Descent into Sheol
action: Continuing their lament (based on the emendation in analysis_context), the Kings and Mighty state that their souls are full of ill-gotten wealth and that this cannot prevent their descent into the flame and pain of Sheol.
actors_involved: The Kings, the Mighty, and the High Ones

title: Judgment before the Son of Man
location: Presence of the Son of Man
action: The faces of the Kings and Mighty are filled with darkness and shame. They are driven away from the presence of the Son of Man, and a sword appears among them.
actors_involved: The Kings, the Mighty, and the High Ones

title: The Lord's Decree
location: Presence of the Lord of Spirits
action: The Lord of Spirits speaks, confirming that this is the ordinance and judgment for the mighty, the kings, the high ones, and those who possess the dry land.
actors_involved: The Kings, the Mighty, and the High Ones

title: The Identification of the Fallen
action: The narrator observes hidden faces in a specific location. A nearby angel identifies these beings as the angels who descended from Heaven to Earth, revealed forbidden knowledge to humanity, and caused them to sin.

title: Vision of the Angels of Punishment
action: The Narrator is shown the Angels of Punishment who are ready to come and unleash all the power of the water from under the earth for judgment and destruction upon all who live on the dry land.

title: The Divine Command to Wait
action: The Lord of Spirits commands the angels who were going out to not act but to keep watch, as they are in charge of the power of the waters.

title: Departure from Enoch
action: The Narrator goes out from the presence of Enoch.

title: Noah's Vision of a Doomed Earth
action: Noah observes that the Earth has tilted and its destruction is imminent.

title: Noah's Journey and Cry
action: Noah travels to the ends of the earth and cries out with a bitter voice to his ancestor, Enoch.

title: Enoch's Arrival
action: Following a great disturbance and a voice from heaven, Enoch appears beside Noah and asks why he is crying.

title: The Divine Decree
action: Enoch explains that a command has been issued from the Lord for the destruction of the inhabitants of the earth because they have learned the forbidden secrets of angels, Satans, and sorcery.

title: The Secret of Metals
action: The narrative explains that metals like lead and tin are not born from the earth in the usual way, but from a special fountain overseen by an angel.

title: Enoch's Consolation
action: Enoch takes Noah by the hand, raises him up, and tells him that he has petitioned the Lord of Spirits concerning the earth's disturbance.

title: The Promise to Noah
action: Enoch relays the Lord of Spirits' message that Noah, being pure and good, will be saved from the judgment. His name and descendants will be established in righteousness for all time.

title: The Handover of Secrets
action: Enoch is given a book that combines the secrets and parables previously revealed to him.

title: The Archangels' Dialogue on Judgment
location: Unspecified, including the Presence of the Lord of Spirits
action: Michael expresses his distress to Raphael over the severe, eternal judgment passed on a group of angels. He recounts standing before the Lord of Spirits and explains the judgment is because they acted with divine likeness. The finality of their sentence is affirmed.

title: The Lord's Word to Noah
action: The Lord speaks to Noah, identifying his righteous portion and instructing him regarding a wooden structure being built by angels, from which a 'seed of life' will come.

title: Promise of Posterity
action: The Lord promises to establish Noah's seed and the seed of those with him, so they will be blessed and multiply upon the earth.

title: The Valley of Judgment
action: Noah describes the burning valley where the angels who showed unrighteousness will be imprisoned, recalling that Enoch had previously seen this place in the west, near mountains of precious metals.

title: The Nature of the Valley
action: The valley is described as a place of great commotion, with agitated waters, a smell of sulfur, and streams of fire where the fallen angels are judged.

title: The Changing Waters
action: The waters are described as a healing agent for kings and the mighty, but also a means of judgment for the angels. The text states the waters will change, becoming cold and eventually an eternal fire, as a consequence of the angels' judgment.

title: Michael's Explanation
action: The angel Michael explains that the judgment of the angels is a testimony for the kings and rulers of the earth. He confirms that the waters of healing will become an eternal, burning fire.

title: The Ascension of the Son of Man
action: The name of the Son of Man is lifted up from among the inhabitants of the earth to the presence of the Lord of Spirits. He is taken up by chariots of spirit.
actors_involved: Those who dwell on the dry ground

title: The Narrator's Relocation
location: Between the East and the West
action: The narrator is taken from among the inhabitants of the earth and placed between two spirits in a celestial location where angels are measuring a dwelling.

title: The Dwelling of the Ancestors
location: Place for the Elect and Righteous
action: The narrator sees the first fathers and the eternal righteous already dwelling in this prepared place.

title: Ascension and First Vision
action: Enoch's spirit ascends and he sees the sons of the holy angels walking on a flame of fire, and two rivers of fire. He falls on his face before the Lord of Spirits.

title: Michael's Guidance
action: The angel Michael lifts Enoch and shows him all the secret places of mercy, righteousness, the ends of heaven, and the storehouses of the stars and lights.

title: The House of Fire
action: Enoch is taken to the Heaven of Heavens and sees a house built of crystal stones, surrounded by rivers of living fire and guarded by the Seraphim, Cherubim, and Ophannin who watch over the Throne of Glory.

title: The Heavenly Host
action: Enoch sees innumerable angels surrounding the house, and the four archangels with other holy angels entering and exiting it.
actors_involved: Holy angels who are above the heavens

title: Appearance of the Head of Days and Enoch's Transformation
action: The Head of Days emerges with the four archangels and a countless host. Upon seeing him, Enoch falls, his flesh melts, and his spirit is transformed.

title: The Revelation of the Son of Man
action: An angel approaches the transformed Enoch, addresses him as the 'Son of Man' born for righteousness, and proclaims that the righteousness of the Head of Days will never forsake him.

title: The Promise of Eternal Peace
action: The angel promises Enoch, as the Son of Man, eternal peace and a permanent dwelling and portion with the righteous.

title: The Law of the Moon
action: The mechanics of the Moon are observed, including its chariot driven by wind, its changing phases of light (waxing and waning in 'seventh parts'), and its cycle of rising and setting in relation to the Sun.

title: The Law of the Moon's Orbit
action: The Narrator observes another law and ordinance for the Moon, concerning its monthly orbit.

title: Uriel's Revelation
action: The holy angel Uriel shows the Narrator the complete system of the luminaries, their stations, and their months, which the Narrator then records.

title: The Moon's Light Cycle
action: The Moon's light is described, how it becomes full in fifteen days, completing its light in the east and west.

title: The Moon's Path Through the Gates
action: The Moon's specific path is detailed: it sets with the Sun in the third and fourth gates, emerges for seven days, returns to the Sun's rising gate, and travels to the sixth gate.

title: The Sun's Path Through the Gates
action: The Sun's path is detailed: it rises from the fourth gate, moves to the fifth, returns to the fourth, goes to the first, and returns again to the fourth.

title: Calendrical Reconciliation
action: The text explains the numerical discrepancies between the solar, lunar, and stellar years, providing calculations for 3, 5, and 8-year cycles to show how the years are brought into alignment.

title: The Celestial Divisions and Intercalary Days
action: The text describes the leaders of the stars and the four special leaders for the intercalary days, noting that men err in their yearly count because of them.

title: Uriel's Revelation of the Luminaries
action: Uriel, sent by the Lord of Glory, reveals to the narrator the purpose of the celestial luminaries (Sun, Moon, Stars) as signs for seasons, years, and days, and as rulers of day and night.

title: The Twelve Gates of Heaven
action: Uriel shows the narrator twelve gates through which the Sun's chariot, heat, winds, dew, and all celestial bodies emerge from east to west according to their seasons. Many windows are also described near these gates.

title: The Celestial Chariots and Unsetting Stars
action: The narrator sees the chariots of heaven running in the cosmos above the gates, carrying the stars that never set. One star is described as the greatest, circling the entire world.

title: The Vision of the Twelve Gates and the Winds
action: The speaker observes twelve heavenly gates at the four cardinal directions. He details the types of winds that emerge from each gate—some beneficial, some destructive—and their effects upon the Earth, its inhabitants, and its ecosystems. He describes the gates of the East, North, South, and West in sequence, before concluding his explanation to his son, Matusala.

title: The Naming of the Winds
action: The first and second winds are named, and the descent of the Most High is described.

title: The West Wind's Domain
action: The west wind, Netug, is described as the place where the luminaries of heaven set.

title: The Division of the World
action: The fourth wind, Mes'e, is described as dividing the world into three parts: the dwelling of men, the waters/darkness, and the Garden of Righteousness.

title: Vision of the Seven Mountains
action: The Narrator sees seven mountains, higher than all others, from which hoarfrost emerges.

title: The Course of the Seven Rivers
action: The Narrator observes the seven great rivers, tracing their paths from the west and north to the Great Sea and the Sea of Erythra.

title: Vision of the Seven Islands
action: The Narrator sees seven great islands located on land and in the sea, with two specifically in the Sea of Erythra.

title: The Naming of the Luminaries
action: The names of the Sun (Oryares, Tomas) and the Moon (Sonya, Ebla, Benase, Era'e) are listed.

title: The Celestial Circuit
action: The two great luminaries set by entering the 'gates of the west', circle 'the north', and rise through the 'gates of the east' to cross the 'face of the sky'.

title: Uriel's Revelation of Light Transfer
action: Uriel shows and explains how light is transferred from the Sun into the Moon.

title: The Lunar Cycle
action: The moon's cycle is detailed: it waxes for 14 days to become full, then wanes for 15 days until its light is gone. Its appearance at night ('like a man') and day ('like the sky') is described.

title: Opposition of Sun and Full Moon
action: At the time of the full moon, the sun sets in the west, and the moon rises from the east to shine all night until the sun rises before it.

title: The Revelation of the Celestial Law
location: A visionary space related to Heaven
action: The Speaker recounts to his son, Methuselah, the complete celestial law that was revealed to him by the angel Uriel. The lesson details the laws governing all time, the cycles of the moon through celestial gates, and the calendrical discrepancy between the lunar and solar years, presenting it all as a divine sign and pattern.

title: Uriel's Prophecy of Cosmic Disorder
location: An abstract visionary space encompassing Heaven and Earth.
action: Uriel reveals to Enoch a future time of judgment ('the days of the sinners') when the laws of nature and the cosmos will be disrupted. Celestial bodies will alter their courses, seasons will fail, agriculture will become barren, and humanity will fall into error, culminating in a destructive plague.
actors_involved: Leaders of the stars of command

title: Reading the Heavenly Records
action: An angelic guide instructs Enoch to observe and read the Heavenly Tablets. Enoch reads the tablets, which contain a book detailing all the deeds of mankind throughout all generations. He then blesses the Lord and declares the righteous man blessed.

title: The Mandate on Earth
location: Earth, at the Door of Enoch's House
action: The Holy Ones bring Enoch back to earth, placing him at the door of his house. They instruct him to inform his son Methuselah and all his children of what he has seen, granting him one year to teach them. They prophesy about the fates of the righteous and the wicked. Afterwards, Enoch goes in to his people, blessing the Lord.

title: Enoch's Charge to Methuselah
action: Enoch addresses his son Methuselah, commanding him to guard the books he has written and to transmit them to all future generations.

title: The Legacy of Wisdom
action: The purpose of the books is explained: to provide wisdom for future generations, who will value it above fine food.

title: The True Calendar Revealed
action: The speaker outlines the 364-day solar year, its division by celestial gates, the four intercalary days, and the error of men who miscalculate it. This knowledge is credited to the angel Uriel, commanded by the Lord.

title: The First Quarter of the Year
action: A description of the first 91-day season, led by Melkiel, detailing its earthly signs (heat, plant growth, harvest) and its subordinate leaders.

title: The Second Quarter of the Year
action: A description of the second 91-day season, led by Helämmemelek, detailing its earthly signs (scorching heat, dryness, ripening, animal mating) and its subordinate leaders.

title: Address to Methuselah
action: Enoch begins to recount two visions to his son, Methuselah.

title: The Vision of Cataclysm
action: Enoch describes a vision he had while lying in his grandfather's house, wherein the sky fell, the earth was swallowed by an abyss, and mountains, hills, and trees were destroyed.

title: Distress and Counsel
action: Enoch cries out in terror after the vision. His grandfather, Mahalalel, raises him, asks why he is crying, and after hearing the vision, confirms its gravity and urges Enoch to pray for a remnant to be saved.

title: Prayer and Record
action: Enoch rises, prays, and writes his prayer down for future generations, concluding his account of the vision to Methuselah.

title: Observing Cosmic Order
action: Enoch goes outside and observes the normal, orderly movement of the sun, moon, and stars, and praises the Lord.

title: Enoch's Prayer of Intercession
action: Enoch lifts his hands and prays to God, blessing Him and speaking about creation. He learns the angels in heaven are accusing humanity, whose sins have brought God's wrath. Enoch then beseeches God not to destroy all of humanity but to save a righteous remnant, while destroying the sinful flesh from the earth.

title: Enoch's Address to Methuselah
action: Enoch tells his son Methuselah to listen to the account of a dream he saw.

title: The Vision Begins: The First Cattle
action: A white cow emerges from the earth, followed by a female heifer and two bull-calves, one black and one red.

title: The First Conflict
action: The black bull-calf gores the red one and pursues it, after which the red bull-calf is no longer seen.

title: The Black Bull's Progeny
action: The black bull-calf grows up and, with another heifer, sires many bulls that resemble it and follow it.

title: The Heifer's Lament
action: The first heifer searches for the lost red bull-calf, lamenting, until the first cow comes and quiets her.

title: The White Lineage Begins
action: The first cow gives birth to another white bull, and then to many other bulls and black heifers.

title: The Great White Bull's Progeny
action: The white bull grows into a great white bull and fathers many white bulls that resemble him, which then continue to multiply.
actors_involved: Many White Bulls (like the great one)

title: The Corruption of the Herd
action: A star falls from the sky and joins a herd of bulls. More bright stars fall, reveal horse-like sexual organs, mount the cows, and cause them to give birth to elephants, camels, and asses.

title: The Devouring
action: The bulls, terrified of the monstrous offspring, react with aggression by goring and grinding their teeth. The offspring then begin to devour the bulls, causing the Children of the Earth to tremble, quake, and flee.

title: Conflict on Earth
action: The narrator observes beings on Earth fighting one another, and the Earth itself cries out.

title: Arrival from Heaven
action: The narrator looks up to heaven and sees a vision of four white beings, in the likeness of men, emerging.

title: Ascension to the Tower
action: Three of the white beings seize the narrator, lift him from the Earth to a high place, and show him a high tower from which the surrounding hill appears low.

title: Imprisonment of the First Star
location: An unspecified area near the Deep Place
action: A ram seizes, binds, and throws the first fallen star into a deep, dark place.

title: The Sword and the Sheep
action: A ram gives a sword to a group of sheep, who then begin to harm one another, causing the earth to quake.

title: Imprisonment of the Great Stars
location: An unspecified area near a chasm
action: After a ram is cast down from heaven, a group of rams gather, bind, and throw a group of great stars into a chasm in the earth.

title: The Summons
action: Enoch, compelled by a voice and spirit, instructs his son Methuselah to gather all their kinsmen. Methuselah departs and fulfills the request.

title: Enoch's Address: The Two Paths
action: Enoch addresses his assembled family, urging them to love and walk in righteousness and to avoid duplicity and association with the double-hearted.

title: Prophecy of Rising Iniquity
action: Enoch foretells a future where violence and lawlessness will grow strong on Earth, culminating in a great plague.

title: Prophecy of Divine Judgment
action: Enoch prophesies that the Holy Lord will emerge in wrath to execute judgment. Iniquity will be uprooted, and the wicked will be cast into a fiery judgment.

title: Prophecy of the Rise of the Righteous
action: Enoch foretells that the righteous and wise will arise. Sinners and evildoers will be destroyed by the sword and other instruments of slaughter.

title: Prophecy of the Weeks
action: Enoch details a chronology of future epochs: the eighth week brings a sword of judgment and building; the ninth brings universal righteous judgment; the tenth brings the great eternal judgment, the passing of the first heaven, and the appearance of a new heaven.

title: Final Exhortation
action: Enoch concludes by reiterating his purpose: to show his children the paths of righteousness and violence, and he urges them to choose the former to avoid eternal destruction.

title: Enoch's Proclamation
action: Enoch, through his written work, delivers a message of wisdom and prophecy to his descendants and all future generations who will live righteously.

title: The Rise of the Righteous
location: Metaphorical space (Paths of Righteousness, Eternal Light)
action: A prophecy is given about the future: the Righteous will arise, walk in paths of righteousness and eternal light, and receive authority, while Sin will be destroyed in darkness.

title: Enoch's Prophecy of the Apocalypse of Weeks
location: An unspecified location where Enoch addresses his children.
action: Enoch, speaking from 'the books' and with authority from heavenly visions, addresses his children. He delivers a prophecy detailing the history and future of the world through the framework of seven symbolic 'weeks,' describing the rise and fall of righteousness, the building and burning of a holy house, and the coming of judgment. He concludes by posing a series of rhetorical questions emphasizing the vast, unknowable nature of God's creation (heaven, earth, stars) compared to the limits of human understanding.

title: The Speaker's Lament
action: A speaker wishes their eyes were a 'cloud of water' so they could weep over an unspecified group and find rest from the sorrow of their heart.

title: Exhortation to the Righteous
action: The righteous are instructed not to fear the sinners, as the Lord will deliver the sinners into their hands, allowing the righteous to act as they please.

title: Woe to the Curse-Pronouncers
action: A woe is pronounced against those who utter curses, stating that healing is far from them because of their sin.

title: Woe to Those Who Repay Evil
action: A woe is pronounced against those who repay their neighbors with evil, warning that they will be repaid according to their own deeds.

title: Woe to the False Witnesses
action: A woe is pronounced against false witnesses who 'weigh out iniquity', warning them of their sudden destruction.

title: Woe to the Persecutors
action: A woe is pronounced against sinners for persecuting the righteous, warning that they themselves will be handed over, persecuted, and burdened by the heavy yoke of their iniquity.

title: Exhortation to the Paths of Righteousness
action: An unnamed speaker instructs 'My Children' to love and walk in the path of righteousness and peace, and to avoid the paths of evil, injustice, and death.

title: Warning Against the Deceit of Sinners
action: The speaker warns his audience not to be led astray by sinners who teach them to do evil.

title: Woes Pronounced on the Wicked
action: A series of woes are pronounced against various groups: those who build injustice, those who build houses with sin, those who acquire wealth, and the rich, detailing their sudden destruction and dispossession.

title: The Day of Judgment
action: The speaker describes the coming day of judgment as one of blood, darkness, and great tribulation, where the Creator will destroy the wicked without mercy and rejoice in their ruin. The righteous of that time will be a spectacle for the sinners and wicked.

title: The Reversal of Fortunes
action: A prophetic declaration that the righteous, who currently suffer, will be exalted with power over the sinners. The sinners, in turn, will be swiftly destroyed.

title: The Exaltation of the Righteous
action: The righteous are described as rising like eagles, inheriting the earth, and receiving healing, light, and a voice of rest from heaven, while the lawless are trampled underfoot.

title: Woes to the Sinners
action: A series of woes are pronounced against various subgroups of sinners for their specific transgressions: the wealthy for their oppression, others for forsaking the 'spring of life', those who commit iniquity, and the mighty for persecuting the righteous. Their coming destruction is announced.

title: A Promise of Judgment
action: The righteous are told to be confident, for the sinners will be destroyed on the day of iniquity.

title: Divine Remembrance and Heavenly Joy
action: The Lord is declared to remember the affliction of the righteous, causing the angels of heaven to rejoice.

title: The Sinners' Flight
action: A rhetorical question is posed to the sinners about where they will flee on the day they hear the prayer of the righteous.

title: Warning Against Partnership
action: An admonition is given not to be partners with the sinners, as a 'matter' will come upon the witnesses.

title: The Ascending Prayer
action: In those days, the prayer of the righteous will reach the Lord, and the days of judgment will reach the sinners.

title: The Public Reckoning
action: Every word of the sinners' iniquity will be read before the Great and Holy One, shaming their faces and casting down their works.

title: Woe to the Sinners
action: A woe is pronounced upon the sinners, who are found in the sea and on dry land.

title: The Boast of Ill-Gotten Wealth
action: The sinners are described as having acquired silver and gold unrighteously, boasting of their wealth, possessions, and ability to do as they please.

title: The Filled Storehouses
action: The sinners continue their boast, claiming to have gathered silver and filled their storehouses as if with plentiful water.

title: The Ephemeral Wealth
action: A prophecy is made that the sinners' falsehoods flow like water and their wealth will not remain, but will quickly ascend from them because it was all acquired through iniquity, leading to a great curse.

title: Pronouncement on Sinners' Wealth and Doom
action: The Speaker addresses the wise and foolish, describing how sinners adorn themselves with wealth and possessions, and prophesies that they and their riches will perish together.

title: Oath on the Human Origin of Sin
action: The Speaker swears an oath that sin was not sent upon the earth but was created by men themselves, and a great curse is for those who practice it.

title: Oath on the Heavenly Record of Sin
action: The Speaker swears by the Great Holy One that all the evil deeds of sinners are openly known and recorded daily in the Heavens before the Most High.

title: Woes and Prophecies of Judgment
action: The Speaker delivers a series of woes to sinners, warning them of the coming 'day of destruction' and 'great condemnation'. They are told they will be handed over to the righteous to be killed, will find no grave, and will die a sudden death for their evil deeds and false words.

title: Condemnation of Deceivers and Perverters of Justice
action: A woe is pronounced against those who practice unrighteousness, praise falsehood, alter the words of righteousness, and transgress the eternal statute, all while declaring themselves sinless.

title: The Righteous Appeal for Judgment
action: In those days, the prayers of the righteous will be raised as a memorial and testimony before the angels, who will in turn place the sins of the sinners before the Most High for remembrance.

title: Prophecy of Social Collapse
action: A prophecy that in those days, nations will be in turmoil, families will rise up against each other, and parents will abandon their own children, showing no mercy.

title: The Folly of Idolatry
action: A woe is pronounced against sinners as the day of slaughter is prepared. They are condemned for worshipping stone, man-made images, evil spirits, and demons, from which they receive no help. Their foolish hearts and blind eyes lead them to ruin.

title: Blessing of the Wise
action: A blessing is given to those who receive the word of wisdom, understand it, and walk in the paths of the Most High and of righteousness, for they will be saved.

title: Condemnation of Social and Economic Sins
action: A series of woes are pronounced against those who harm their neighbor, build on foundations of sin, construct their houses with the exploited labor of others, and wrongfully remove ancestral landmarks to follow idols.

title: The Final Judgment
action: On the great day of destruction, the glory of the violent sinners will be cast down. The spirit of the Most High's anger will rise to destroy them all with the sword, while the holy and righteous remember their sins.

title: The Great Slaughter
action: In a time of great chaos, family members and friends kill one another from dawn to dusk, causing a stream of blood to form that is deep enough to reach a horse's chest and submerge a chariot.

title: The Gathering for Judgment
action: Angels descend to Earth, find all the sinners in hidden places, and gather them into one location. The Most High arises to execute a great judgment upon them.

title: Protection of the Righteous
action: Holy angels are assigned as guards to protect the righteous and holy until all evil and sin are destroyed, ensuring they have nothing to fear.

title: Cosmic and Natural Judgment
action: The sinners are told their deeds are known in heaven, witnessed by the sun, moon, and stars. They will be judged with fire, and natural elements like rain, dew, frost, and snow will be withheld or turned against them as punishment.

title: Admonition to the Children of Heaven
action: An unnamed speaker commands the 'children of heaven' to ask heaven, fear the Most High, and do no evil.

title: The Withholding of Rain
action: A hypothetical scenario where the Most High shuts the windows of heaven, stopping rain and dew from falling on the earth.

title: The Sending of Wrath
action: A hypothetical scenario where the Most High sends his wrath upon people for their deeds and hard words against his righteousness.

title: The Peril of the Sea Kings
action: The kings of the sea are tossed by waves and winds, and their ships are broken.

title: The Fear of the Sea Kings
action: The kings of the sea fear for their possessions and their lives, anticipating that the sea will swallow them and they will be destroyed.

title: The Dominion over the Sea
action: A declaration that the sea, its waters, and its movements are the work of the Most High, who has sealed and bound it.

title: The Rebuke of the Sea
action: At the Most High's rebuke, the sea is afraid and dries up, killing all its fish and everything within it. This is contrasted with the sinners on earth who do not fear him.

title: The Creator's Wisdom
action: A rhetorical question affirming that the Most High created heaven, earth, and all within them, and gave instruction and wisdom to all beings on land and in the sea.
actors_involved: all who move on the earth

title: A Contrast of Fear
action: A final statement contrasting the fear the kings of the sea have for the sea with the sinners' lack of fear for the Most High.

title: The Day of Judgment's Terror
action: A divine judgment descends with fire and words, causing the luminaries, the earth, angels, and humanity to tremble in great fear. The sinners are declared cursed and without peace.

title: The Fate of the Righteous Souls
action: The souls of the righteous are addressed and told not to fear or be sad that they have descended into Sheol in sorrow, as this happened on the day of cursing and punishment for sinners.

title: The Sinners' Mockery
action: Living sinners observe the death of the righteous and conclude that death is the final end, seeing no advantage in righteousness and declaring themselves equal in fate. They believe the righteous will never see light again.

title: Rebuke to the Sinners
action: The sinners are rebuked for their indulgent and violent lives. They are told to look at the true end of the righteous: they perished, became as though they had not been, and their souls descended into Sheol in tribulation.

title: The Heavenly Revelation
action: The speaker declares he has read the secrets of the future from the Heavenly Tablets written by the Holy Ones and will now reveal them.

title: The Reward of the Righteous
action: The fate of the righteous after death is described: their spirits will live, rejoice, and receive a great reward for their earthly toil, remembered before the Great One.

title: The Punishment of the Sinners
action: The fate of the sinners is described: after a prosperous life, their spirits are brought down into Sheol to face eternal tribulation in darkness and fire.

title: The Lament of the Living
action: The righteous lament their suffering in life, describing how they are oppressed, devoured, and killed by the sinners, and how their cries to rulers for help go unheard.

title: The Heavenly Record
location: Before the Glory of the Great One
action: Angels make mention of the righteous' memorial and write their names before the Great One.

title: Promise of Glorification
action: The righteous are promised that their suffering will end, they will shine like the light of heaven, the gates of heaven will open for them, and they will have great joy like the angels.

title: Warning against Association with Sinners
action: The righteous are warned not to fear the prosperity of sinners, not to be their companions, and to stay away from their violence, because the destiny of the righteous is to be companions of the host of heaven.

title: The Unseen Record of Sin
action: Sinners are addressed, who believe their sins are not recorded. They are told that all their sins are written down daily, and that light and darkness (day and night) witness all their sins.

title: The Falsehood of Sinners
action: Sinners are described as falsifying the word of truth, lying, creating great fabrications, and writing their own false books while praising their idols.

title: The True Scribes
action: In contrast to the sinners, the righteous are instructed to write down all the speaker's words truthfully in their own languages, without altering or diminishing them.

title: The Gift of Wisdom
action: Books of joy, righteousness, and wisdom are given to the righteous and the wise. They believe in them, rejoice, and are rewarded for learning the paths of righteousness from them.

title: The Lord's Promise of Union
action: The Lord delivers a speech, commanding guides to teach the children of the earth and promising that He and His Son will be joined with them forever in righteousness and peace.

title: The Wondrous Birth
action: After some days, Methuselah gave a wife to his son Lamech. She conceived and bore a son whose appearance was extraordinary: his body was white as snow and red as a rose, his hair was like white wool, and his eyes, when opened, illuminated the entire house like the sun.

title: The Child Speaks
action: The newborn child rises from the midwife's hands, opens his mouth, and speaks to the Lord of Righteousness.

title: Lamech's Fear and Flight
action: Lamech, his father, is terrified. He believes the child is not his but is like one of the angels of heaven. He runs to his own father (Methuselah, to get to Enoch) to learn the truth.

title: Enoch's Revelation of the Past
action: Lamech reaches Enoch and asks for the truth. Enoch explains that he has seen in a vision that the Lord is bringing something new to the earth. He recounts that in the generation of his father Jared, angels sinned with women, fathering giants and bringing a great plague and corruption upon the earth.

title: Enoch's Prophecy of the Future
action: Enoch reveals that the child is truly Lamech's son and should be named Noah. He prophesies that Noah and his three sons will survive a great flood that will cleanse the earth. Enoch, having read the heavenly tablets, foretells that after the flood, wickedness will increase again, but eventually a generation of righteousness will arise and sin will be purged from the earth.

title: Enoch's Secret Counsel
action: Enoch commands his son, Methuselah, to go to Lamech and reassure him that his newborn son is truly his own. This information is conveyed secretly.

title: The Naming of Noah
action: After hearing Enoch's words, Methuselah returns to Lamech's location and names the child Noah, stating that he will bring comfort to the earth.

title: Enoch's Inscription
action: Enoch writes a book for his son Methuselah and for future generations of the righteous.

title: Vision of the Fiery Abyss
action: Enoch sees a vision of a desolate, fiery place of punishment, filled with wailing and turmoil.

title: The Angel's Explanation
action: A guiding angel explains to Enoch that the place he sees is the prison for the spirits of sinners.

title: The Lord's Proclamation of Salvation
action: The Lord declares that He will transform those born in darkness, bring them into light, and set them on thrones of honor.

title: The Final Judgment
action: The righteous are seen shining while the wicked are led into darkness and go to their appointed place of doom.
